regions.name: Northern and Central Areas
regions.where: Most of the island: the north, the central highlands, the west and the east coast down to about Taolagnaro (purple on the locator map); everything except the far south and south-west
regions.notes: Lean box drawn mid-Jan to mid-Apr (both edges on mid-month ticks). Rice planting has an unlabelled Jan piece, read as the continuation of the Oct-Dec 'Main Season' bar. Off-season rice is planted Jul-Sep in the dry season and has no rainy season. Cyclone season (Jan-Apr, Nov-Dec), green harvest of maize (Feb-Mar) and cash-crop labour (Jul-Dec) not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Main season rice harvest (Apr 48%); Main harvest: maize, beans (Mar 50%); Lean Season (Jan 48%, Apr 48%).

regions.name: Southern Areas
regions.where: Far south and south-west (purple on the locator map): Atsimo Andrefana from the Mangoky southward, Androy and most of Anosy west of Taolagnaro
regions.notes: Lean box drawn in two pieces (Nov-Dec and Jan to mid-Mar), recorded as one Nov-Mar season. Rice harvest bars are labelled 'Main Season' (Jun-Jul) and 'Off-Ssn' (Dec). Sweet potato is planted Feb-Mar inside the rainy season, so its Jul-Sep harvest is linked to it; the image does not label this. Cyclone season, green harvest, labour, milk and wild food bars not recorded. Edges at or near a mid-month tick, counted as covering the month (share of that month covered in brackets): Main harvest: maize, beans (Mar 50%, May 49%); Cassava harvest (Jul 50%); Lean Season (Mar 47%); Planting: maize, beans (Jan 49%).

assign.method: Regions read off the two locator maps; the southern area matches Atsimo Andrefana, Androy and most of Anosy, all other regions are northern and central.

transcriber_notes: The southern area's boundary does not follow region lines exactly: the humid east-coast strip around Taolagnaro (Anosy) is shown with the northern/central areas, and the line runs close to Ihorombe's southern edge. Several edges are on mid-month ticks and were counted (see region notes).
